# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Placeholder embedded sounds: one short synthesized tone per category
# (Brass/Woodwinds/Strings/...), generated by PlaceholderSamples/
# generate_placeholders.py rather than real recordings -- stands in for
# actual sample content until real audio is recorded/licensed, so the full
# click-a-category -> click-a-sound -> hear it play pipeline can be tested
# end-to-end today. Swapping these out later for real samples only means
# replacing these .wav files and re-running the generator script's
# equivalent (or just dropping in real recordings under the same names) --
# no code changes needed, since loadEmbeddedSamples() just decodes whatever
# audio is embedded here.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
juce_add_binary_data(MentalsSamplerPlaceholderData
    HEADER_NAME PlaceholderBinaryData.h
    NAMESPACE PlaceholderBinaryData
    SOURCES
        PlaceholderSamples/Brass.wav
        PlaceholderSamples/Woodwinds.wav
        PlaceholderSamples/Strings.wav
        PlaceholderSamples/Mallets.wav
        PlaceholderSamples/Percussion.wav
        PlaceholderSamples/Choir.wav
        PlaceholderSamples/Keys.wav
        PlaceholderSamples/Bass.wav
        PlaceholderSamples/Synth.wav
        PlaceholderSamples/Guitar.wav
        PlaceholderSamples/Organ.wav
        PlaceholderSamples/Bells.wav)

add_library(MentalsSamplerCore STATIC
    PluginProcessor.cpp
    PluginEditor.cpp)

_juce_initialise_target(MentalsSamplerCore)

target_include_directories(MentalsSamplerCore PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})

juce_generate_juce_header(MentalsSamplerCore)

target_compile_definitions(MentalsSamplerCore
    PUBLIC
        JUCE_WEB_BROWSER=0
        JUCE_USE_CURL=0
        JUCE_VST3_CAN_REPLACE_VST2=0)

target_link_libraries(MentalsSamplerCore
    PUBLIC
        MentalsUI
        MentalsSamplerPlaceholderData
        juce::juce_audio_utils
        juce::juce_audio_formats
        juce::juce_dsp
        juce::juce_recommended_config_flags
        juce::juce_recommended_lto_flags
        juce::juce_recommended_warning_flags)

juce_add_plugin(MentalsSampler
    COMPANY_NAME "YourCompany"
    IS_SYNTH TRUE
    NEEDS_MIDI_INPUT TRUE
    NEEDS_MIDI_OUTPUT FALSE
    IS_MIDI_EFFECT FALSE
    EDITOR_WANTS_KEYBOARD_FOCUS FALSE
    COPY_PLUGIN_AFTER_BUILD FALSE
    PLUGIN_MANUFACTURER_CODE Ycmp
    PLUGIN_CODE Msmp
    FORMATS AU VST3 Standalone
    PRODUCT_NAME "Mentals Sampler")

juce_generate_juce_header(MentalsSampler)

target_sources(MentalsSampler
    PRIVATE
        CreatePluginFilter.cpp)

target_link_libraries(MentalsSampler
    PRIVATE
        MentalsSamplerCore)
